title: CANS cross-tool glossary
description: Shared, git-tracked bank-vocabulary glossary (01c Phase 2). Consulted by the confluence-search agent AND the JIRA jira-helper so a query like 'NTB acting as a POBO' is understood, not fumbled. Every entry is HUMAN-CONFIRMED on write — never guessed and silently persisted (ask-last resolution order: glossary -> specs/ -> local mirrors -> ask). Stores meaning + provenance POINTERS only; NEVER secrets or restricted page body text. Tool-neutral by design: keyed by the term, no tool-specific fields.

terms.description: Map of TERM (as written, e.g. an acronym like POBO) -> its resolved meaning. Lookup is case-insensitive via the `aliases` array; the key is the canonical display form.

expansion.description: The full-text expansion of the term, e.g. 'Payment On Behalf Of' for POBO. Used to expand the search query before calling Rovo/CQL.

definition.description: A one-to-two sentence plain-language meaning. Paraphrased — never a verbatim copy of restricted page content.

provenance.description: Where the meaning was established. POINTERS ONLY — a sourceRef plus an optional short paraphrased quote. Never restricted body text.

source.description: A pointer, not content. e.g. 'confluence:PCON:2042342654', 'jira:CANS-123', 'specs/business-requirements.md', or a URL. Recorded even for restricted pages (the pointer is safe; the body is not copied).

quote.description: OPTIONAL short paraphrase of the defining sentence. Omit or null for restricted sources — keep the pointer, drop the text.

confidence.description: How direct the evidence was. 'high' = an explicit definition/first-use expansion; 'low' = inferred from usage.

aliases.description: Case/format variants that resolve to this entry, e.g. ['pobo', 'payment-on-behalf-of']. Matched case-insensitively during term resolution.

relatedTerms.description: Other glossary keys worth surfacing alongside this one, e.g. POBO relatedTerms ['NTB', 'delegated-authority'].

confirmedBy.description: Provenance of the WRITE itself. Always 'human' — this glossary is human-confirmed on write, with no exceptions. An entry with any other value is invalid and must not exist.

confirmedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the human confirmation.
